notes: #10 is a 1248 px crop of Bonnart’s 1700 painting, slightly under 1280 px; #8 (Israël Silvestre, about 1654, palace seen from the river, high resolution) is a strong black-and-white alternative for P2. #19 is the Flickr copy of a Library of Congress photochrom (the uploader states it is public domain; file page says CC BY 2.0). #15 (photochrom panorama from the Île de la Barthelasse) is an alternative for P4. #12 (Marlow) shows Villeneuve-lès-Avignon, #21/#22/#25 are a 17th-century Fouquier landscape (1945-I is the museum number, not a date), #26 is a photo of an undated Paul Huet painting. P6 is weak: no good modern photo of the Palace of the Popes among the candidates; #28 shows mainly Villeneuve across the river.
